events.title: Marriage and family
events.description: Married Seviah, daughter of James Sands; children Othniel, Abigail, Sands, Jessie, Abner, Sarah and Seviah. [R4-S1]

bio: A son of Job Smith 1st and Elizabeth Thompson (John's 10th-great-grandparents), so a brother of John's 9th-great-grandfather James Smith and John's 9th-great-granduncle. Thompson's Smith account ([R4-S1]) gives his wife Seviah Sands and their children, including the patriot Abner Smith.
sources: [R4-S1] B. F. Thompson, History of Long Island, 3rd ed. (1918), vol. 3 (archive.org full text), p. 377 (secondary) https://archive.org/details/historyoflongisl003thom
